response.reason: The kernel computes sigmoid in FP32 (libdevice exp has up to ~2 ulp error, and div_rn rounds to FP32) and then converts FP32→FP16, so the result is double-rounded rather than the required single rounding of the true value to binary16. Values whose exact sigmoid lies within an FP32-ulp of an FP16 rounding midpoint (statistically several across the 65k+ finite FP16 inputs) can produce a different bit pattern than the FP64-then-round reference, violating the exact-rounding contract.
